method.source: Independent minidom text-node event stream over twenty-one SHA-pinned XML files and ten accepted Niese identity registries, without production extractor imports. The complete witness is embedded and checked against its standalone file.
method.tokens: Every Unicode-category token and UTF-16 offset is checked against each bundle; a separate JavaScript character scanner agrees on every physical source span, including zero-width TEI gaps within a character run.
method.queries: Independent AST/set Boolean logic, regular-expression globs, and sequential phrase scanning. Phrase barriers derive from witness source marks and explicit source-division boundaries.
method.vocabulary: Every distinct source token in every book queried in source-spelling and u/v–i/j-folded modes.
method.boundaries: Every within-book adjacent physical pair, all 27 literal source interruptions, all 36 TEI gaps, X.108 empty interval, IX missing 51–109, the Proem-to-narrative boundary, the two explicit registered source discontinuities, the XVII.41–42 letter-run seam, and every book junction checked. Displaced fragments share Boolean citation identity while phrases follow physical order. Uncertain sentence punctuation remains ordinarily joinable.
method.collection: All twenty Antiquities bundles, selected subsets and order, limited four-work integration queries, caching, invalid selection and unavailable-book rejection.

No independent Latin interval. The full reviewed Latin context has no identifiable counterpart of this section's separate account of Simon's appointment as high priest, liberation from Macedonian tribute and the 170-year chronology. The documentary dating formula within XIII.212 corresponds to Greek XIII.214 and does not supply this liberation account. The earlier military appointment in latin-book13-num201 is a different account. Greek and English remain independently accessible; no cause, physical loss or tradition-wide absence is inferred.

limitations: Automated Node/Python acceptance, not browser or visual acceptance.
Reader URLs are verified with the actual UI URL helper; reader pages are not opened by this verifier.
The accepted corrected project XML is preserved faithfully; this does not re-collate the text with manuscript images.
Earlier collections receive limited mixed-work integration checks; their independent source-fidelity reports remain separately required.
Literal source interruptions conservatively suppress phrase adjacency without assigning new scholarly meanings or missing-text extents.
